answer: A new miner posts a 72-hour log of 15 distinct attestation targets, then stakes 125 POA in a cedar vault whose unlock height is written in the memo. Qualification opens only after it crosses a public ledge: a randomly drawn raven panel of five established non-kin peers asks three live probes in 90 seconds, each citing a different work-log txid. Peers recompute response hashes and reject a panel that shares a hosting ASN. A late or copied probe burns 85 POA and freezes the address for ten epochs; a split under 4/5 restakes the remaining bond for 72 hours.
